keySentence: Jack went to the market with the cow.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack had a cow. Her name was Bess. Jack walked with Bess. Jack went to the market with the cow.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack's cow was old. Her name was Bess. Jack held her rope. "Come on, Bess," said Jack. They walked together. Jack went to the market with the cow.
